[TWO-COLUMN IMAGE: LEFT shows 'Typical Lead' with just 'John Smith (555) 123-4567' | RIGHT shows 'Nook Lead' with rich details]

flooring.preview: Turn browsers into buyers before they visit your showroom
flooring.body:
Hi {{First_Name}},

Most flooring retailers treat their website like a brochure. Visitors browse products, maybe fill out a contact form, then show up to the showroom still figuring out what they want.

Nook turns your website into the start of the sale.

[IMAGE: Nook embedded on flooring website showing interactive planning tool]

→ They narrow material options (hardwood, LVP, tile, carpet)

→ They build a plan that your team can see and work from

By the time they reach out, they're not just curious — they're ready to move forward.

title: How flooring teams close faster with Nook

flooring.subject: How flooring teams close faster with Nook
flooring.preview: Before and after: scattered follow-up vs. one workspace
flooring.body:
Hi {{First_Name}},

I've been talking a lot about lead capture, but that's just the beginning.

The real value is what happens after the first visit.

[BEFORE/AFTER IMAGE: LEFT shows chaos (texts, emails, PDFs scattered) | RIGHT shows clean Nook workspace]

Before Nook, follow-up looks like this:

→ Texting product photos back and forth
→ Emailing PDFs that get lost in inboxes
→ Customers forgetting what was discussed
→ Reps starting over when someone else picks up the conversation

With Nook, everything stays in one shared workspace:

→ Product cards with pricing and specs
→ Messaging and commenting on specific items
→ Updated plans that reflect decisions in real time
→ Full visibility for the whole team

Flooring retailers tell us it cuts days off the decision cycle and makes premium upgrades easier to close.

[BUTTON: Book a 15-Minute Demo]

Marc Signer
Founder, Nook
